The base-pattern edge has only n=8 samples - too thin to lean on, and today's tape isn't actually a quiet base: it's a confirmed downtrend with vol_surge 0.21 (quiet volume) but negative price momentum, not consolidation. On valuation, the bull is cherry-picking the single most optimistic of three methods (relative-PE, 55.22) while the majority - earnings power (37.6) and Graham (41.08) - agree the stock is overvalued; averaging methods rather than picking the friendliest one is why the composite lands at 41.08, not 55.

house_view.summary: TA and FA converge on caution: price sits below both SMA20 and SMA50 in a confirmed downtrend, while the valuation model's earnings-power and Graham methods agree the stock is roughly 35% rich versus the 62.84 print. A thin 2% net margin and zero dividend leave no cushion or income offset while the trend still points down. The bull case leans on a single outlier valuation method (relative-PE, 55.22) and an 8-trade sample pattern, both thinner evidence than the bear's converging methods. The Jul 27, 2026 earnings print is the live near-term catalyst that could confirm margin pressure or offer the first real test of a base.
